personal.name: Home Insurance
personal.title_tag: Home Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
personal.meta_description: Home insurance protects your house, belongings, and liability in Kentucky. The Way Agency represents top-rated carriers to find the right coverage and price.
personal.h1: What does home insurance cover in Kentucky?
personal.summary: Covers your home's structure, personal belongings, and liability if someone is injured on your property. Required by most mortgage lenders. Does not include flood or earthquake damage.
personal.ky_requirement: Required by mortgage lenders. Not required by state law for homes owned outright.

personal.name: Auto Insurance
personal.title_tag: Auto Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
personal.meta_description: Auto insurance in Kentucky with minimum 25/50/25 liability. The Way Agency compares top-rated carriers to find the best coverage for your situation.
personal.h1: What auto insurance do you need in Kentucky?
personal.summary: Covers liability for injuries and property damage you cause, plus optional collision, comprehensive, and uninsured motorist protection. Kentucky requires minimum 25/50/25 liability limits.
personal.typical_cost_range: $1,000–$2,800/year depending on driving record and coverage
personal.ky_requirement: Kentucky requires minimum liability limits of 25/50/25 ($25K per person, $50K per accident bodily injury, $25K property damage). Also requires $10K PIP.
common_exclusions: personal belongings in vehicle (covered by home/renters)

personal.name: Renters Insurance
personal.title_tag: Renters Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
personal.meta_description: Renters insurance protects your belongings and liability as a tenant. Affordable coverage from $15/month in Kentucky.
personal.h1: Do you need renters insurance in Kentucky?
personal.summary: Protects your personal belongings, provides liability coverage, and covers additional living expenses if your rental becomes unlivable. Typically $15–$30/month.
personal.ky_requirement: Not required by Kentucky law, but many landlords require it as a lease condition.

personal.name: Umbrella Insurance
personal.title_tag: Umbrella Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
personal.meta_description: Umbrella insurance adds extra liability protection beyond your home and auto policy limits. Policies start at $1M for around $200–$400/year.
personal.h1: What is umbrella insurance and do you need it?
personal.summary: Adds an extra layer of liability protection above your home and auto policy limits. Covers lawsuits, legal fees, and judgments that exceed your underlying policy limits.
personal.ky_requirement: Not required by law, but strongly recommended for homeowners, landlords, and anyone with significant assets.

personal.name: Flood Insurance
personal.title_tag: Flood Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
personal.meta_description: Flood damage is NOT covered by standard homeowners insurance. Learn about NFIP and private flood insurance options in Kentucky.
personal.h1: Is flood insurance required in Kentucky?
personal.summary: Standard homeowners insurance does not cover flood damage. Separate flood policies are available through the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) or private carriers.
personal.typical_cost_range: $500–$2,500/year depending on flood zone and elevation
cost_factors: elevation relative to base flood elevation
personal.ky_requirement: Required by mortgage lenders if your property is in a FEMA-designated Special Flood Hazard Area (Zone A or V). Optional but recommended for all homeowners near waterways.
common_exclusions: vehicles damaged by flood (covered by auto comp)

personal.name: Motorcycle Insurance
personal.title_tag: Motorcycle Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
personal.meta_description: Motorcycle insurance in Kentucky covers liability, collision, and comprehensive protection. Required by state law for registered bikes.
personal.h1: What motorcycle insurance is required in Kentucky?
personal.summary: Covers liability, collision, and comprehensive protection for your motorcycle. Kentucky requires the same minimum liability limits as auto insurance (25/50/25).
personal.typical_cost_range: $300–$1,500/year depending on bike type and riding history
personal.ky_requirement: Kentucky requires minimum liability of 25/50/25 for registered motorcycles, same as auto.
common_exclusions: custom parts above stated value (without endorsement)

personal.name: Boat Insurance
personal.title_tag: Boat Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
personal.meta_description: Boat and watercraft insurance in Kentucky. Coverage for your vessel, liability, and passengers on the Ohio River and Kentucky Lake.
personal.h1: Do you need boat insurance in Kentucky?
personal.summary: Covers your watercraft, equipment, liability for injuries or property damage, and towing/salvage. Kentucky does not require boat insurance by law, but marinas and lenders typically do.
personal.typical_cost_range: $200–$1,000/year depending on boat type and value
personal.ky_requirement: Not required by Kentucky law. Required by most marinas and lenders. Recommended for anyone operating on the Ohio River, Kentucky Lake, or other waterways.

personal.name: Classic Car Insurance
personal.title_tag: Classic Car Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
personal.meta_description: Classic and antique car insurance with agreed value coverage. Protect your investment with specialized policies from The Way Agency.
personal.h1: How is classic car insurance different from regular auto insurance?
personal.summary: Insures collector, antique, and classic vehicles at an agreed value rather than depreciated actual cash value. Typically requires limited-use mileage restrictions and enclosed storage.
personal.ky_requirement: Same minimum liability requirements as standard auto (25/50/25). Classic car policies add agreed-value physical damage coverage.
common_exclusions: daily driver use exceeding mileage limits

personal.name: Earthquake Insurance
personal.title_tag: Earthquake Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
personal.meta_description: Western Kentucky is in the New Madrid Seismic Zone. Earthquake damage is NOT covered by homeowners insurance. Learn about coverage options.
personal.h1: Do you need earthquake insurance in western Kentucky?
personal.summary: Standard homeowners insurance excludes earthquake damage. Western Kentucky sits on the New Madrid Seismic Zone, one of the most active fault systems east of the Rockies. Separate earthquake policies or endorsements are available.
cost_factors: proximity to New Madrid fault zone
personal.ky_requirement: Not required by law or lenders, but strongly recommended in western Kentucky due to New Madrid Seismic Zone proximity.

personal.name: Pet Insurance
personal.title_tag: Pet Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
personal.meta_description: Pet insurance covers veterinary costs for accidents and illness. Plans available for dogs and cats in Kentucky starting around $30/month.
personal.summary: Reimburses veterinary costs for accidents, illnesses, and sometimes routine care. Helps avoid choosing between your pet's health and a surprise $3,000+ vet bill.
personal.ky_requirement: Not required. Purely optional coverage for pet owners who want financial protection against unexpected vet costs.

commercial.name: General Liability
commercial.title_tag: General Liability Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
commercial.meta_description: General liability insurance protects your business from bodily injury and property damage claims. Required by most KY leases and contracts.
commercial.h1: What does general liability insurance cover?
commercial.summary: Covers your business if a customer, vendor, or visitor is injured at your location, or if your work damages someone else's property. Most commercial leases and contracts in Kentucky require it.
commercial.ky_requirement: Not required by Kentucky law for all businesses, but required by most commercial leases, vendor contracts, and government permits.

commercial.name: Commercial Property
commercial.title_tag: Commercial Property Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
commercial.meta_description: Commercial property insurance protects your building, equipment, inventory, and business income in Kentucky.
commercial.h1: What does commercial property insurance cover?
commercial.summary: Protects your business's physical assets: the building you own or lease, equipment, inventory, furniture, and business income lost during a covered event.
commercial.typical_cost_range: $750–$5,000/year depending on property value and industry
commercial.ky_requirement: Required by commercial mortgage lenders. Recommended for any business with physical assets.

commercial.name: Commercial Auto
commercial.title_tag: Commercial Auto Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
commercial.meta_description: Commercial auto insurance for business vehicles, fleets, and employees who drive for work in Kentucky.
commercial.h1: When do you need commercial auto insurance?
commercial.summary: Covers vehicles owned or used by your business, including company cars, trucks, vans, and fleets. Personal auto policies typically exclude vehicles used for business purposes.
commercial.ky_requirement: Kentucky requires same minimum liability for commercial vehicles as personal (25/50/25). Higher limits are typically required by contracts and prudent risk management.

commercial.name: Workers Compensation
commercial.title_tag: Workers Compensation Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
commercial.meta_description: Workers comp covers medical costs and lost wages for employees injured on the job. Required in Kentucky for most employers.
commercial.h1: Is workers compensation required in Kentucky?
commercial.summary: Covers medical expenses, rehabilitation, and lost wages for employees injured on the job. Kentucky requires workers comp for most employers with one or more employees.
commercial.typical_cost_range: Varies by payroll and industry classification. Rates range from $0.30 to $15+ per $100 of payroll.
commercial.ky_requirement: Kentucky requires workers compensation for all employers with one or more employees, with limited exceptions for certain agricultural and domestic workers.

commercial.name: Cyber Insurance
commercial.title_tag: Cyber Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
commercial.meta_description: Cyber insurance covers data breaches, ransomware, and business interruption from cyber attacks. Essential for businesses handling customer data.
commercial.h1: Does your business need cyber insurance?
commercial.summary: Covers costs from data breaches, ransomware attacks, and cyber extortion: forensic investigation, customer notification, credit monitoring, legal defense, regulatory fines, and business income lost during an attack.
commercial.ky_requirement: Not required by Kentucky law, but effectively required if you handle customer financial data, health records, or are subject to contractual obligations.
common_exclusions: loss of future revenue beyond policy period

commercial.name: Surety Bonds
commercial.title_tag: Surety Bonds in Kentucky | The Way Agency
commercial.meta_description: Surety bonds guarantee your contractual obligations. Required for contractors, notaries, and licensed professionals in Kentucky.
commercial.h1: What is a surety bond and when do you need one?
commercial.summary: A three-party guarantee: the bonding company guarantees to a project owner (obligee) that your business (principal) will fulfill contractual obligations. If you don't, the bond pays the claim.
commercial.typical_cost_range: 1%–15% of the bond amount, depending on credit and bond type
commercial.ky_requirement: Required for many Kentucky contractor licenses, notary commissions, court proceedings, and government contracts.
common_exclusions: Bonds are not insurance  -  if the bond company pays a claim, you owe them back. This is different from insurance where the carrier absorbs the loss.

commercial.name: Builders Risk
commercial.title_tag: Builders Risk Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
commercial.meta_description: Builders risk insurance covers buildings and materials during construction. Essential for contractors and property owners in Kentucky.
commercial.summary: Covers a building under construction, renovation, or addition  -  including the structure, materials, and equipment on site  -  against fire, wind, theft, and other covered perils during the construction period.
commercial.ky_requirement: Not required by Kentucky law, but typically required by construction contracts, lenders, and project owners.

commercial.name: Special Event Insurance
commercial.title_tag: Special Event Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
commercial.meta_description: Special event insurance covers liability, cancellation, and property damage for weddings, festivals, and corporate events in Kentucky.
commercial.h1: Do you need insurance for your event?
commercial.summary: Provides liability coverage and optional cancellation protection for one-time events: weddings, festivals, corporate events, fundraisers, and community gatherings. Most venues in Kentucky require proof of event insurance.
commercial.typical_cost_range: $75–$500 per event depending on size and type
commercial.ky_requirement: Not required by law, but required by most venues, parks, and event spaces as a condition of rental.
common_exclusions: professional entertainer injuries (they need their own coverage)

commercial.name: Professional Liability
commercial.title_tag: Professional Liability Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
commercial.meta_description: Professional liability (E&O) insurance protects against claims of mistakes, negligence, or failure to perform professional services.
commercial.summary: Also called Errors & Omissions (E&O) insurance. Covers claims that your professional advice, services, or work product caused a client financial harm due to mistakes, negligence, or failure to deliver.
commercial.ky_requirement: Not required by Kentucky law for all professions, but required by many professional licensing boards and client contracts.

life_health.name: Medicare
life_health.title_tag: Medicare Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
life_health.meta_description: Understanding Medicare in Kentucky: Original Medicare, Medicare Advantage, Medigap supplements, and Part D drug plans explained.
life_health.h1: How does Medicare work in Kentucky?
life_health.summary: Federal health insurance for people 65+ or with qualifying disabilities. Original Medicare (Parts A & B) covers hospital and medical services. Gaps can be filled with Medicare Supplement (Medigap) or Medicare Advantage (Part C) plans.

life_health.name: Medicaid
life_health.title_tag: Medicaid in Kentucky | The Way Agency
life_health.meta_description: Understanding Medicaid eligibility and coverage in Kentucky. Information about Kentucky's expanded Medicaid program.
life_health.h1: Who qualifies for Medicaid in Kentucky?
life_health.summary: State and federal health coverage for low-income individuals and families. Kentucky expanded Medicaid under the ACA, covering adults up to 138% of the federal poverty level.

life_health.name: Supplemental Health
life_health.title_tag: Supplemental Health Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
life_health.meta_description: Supplemental health insurance pays cash benefits for accidents, critical illness, and hospital stays to cover gaps in your primary health plan.
life_health.h1: What does supplemental health insurance cover?
life_health.summary: Pays cash benefits directly to you when a covered health event occurs  -  accident, critical illness, or hospital stay. Helps cover deductibles, copays, lost income, and other expenses your primary health plan doesn't pay.

life_health.name: Group Health
life_health.title_tag: Group Health Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
life_health.meta_description: Group health insurance for Kentucky businesses. Compare plans, control costs, and offer competitive benefits to attract talent.
life_health.h1: How does group health insurance work for small businesses?
life_health.summary: Health coverage sponsored by an employer for employees and often their dependents. Small businesses (2–50 employees) in Kentucky can access group plans through the small group market with community-rated premiums.

life_health.name: Individual Health
life_health.title_tag: Individual Health Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
life_health.meta_description: Individual and family health insurance options in Kentucky, including marketplace plans with subsidies and off-exchange alternatives.
life_health.h1: How do you get health insurance in Kentucky without an employer plan?
life_health.summary: Individual health plans purchased through Kentucky's health insurance marketplace (kynect) or directly from carriers. Subsidies are available based on income. Open enrollment is typically November through January.

life_health.name: Family Health
life_health.title_tag: Family Health Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
life_health.meta_description: Family health insurance plans in Kentucky. Compare marketplace plans, employer options, and CHIP for children.
life_health.h1: What are your family health insurance options in Kentucky?
life_health.summary: Covers you, your spouse, and dependent children under one policy. Available through employer plans, the Kentucky marketplace (kynect), or individual carriers. KCHIP provides low-cost coverage for children in families that earn too much for Medicaid.

life_health.name: Dental, Vision & Hearing
life_health.title_tag: Dental & Vision Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
life_health.meta_description: Standalone dental, vision, and hearing insurance plans in Kentucky. Coverage for routine care and major services.
life_health.h1: Do you need separate dental and vision insurance?
life_health.summary: Most health insurance plans do not include dental, vision, or hearing coverage for adults. Standalone plans cover preventive care, exams, and major services at a fraction of out-of-pocket cost.

life_health.name: Term Life
life_health.title_tag: Term Life Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
life_health.meta_description: Term life insurance provides affordable death benefit protection for a fixed period. Compare 10, 20, and 30-year term options.
life_health.h1: How much term life insurance do you need?
life_health.summary: Pays a death benefit to your beneficiaries if you die during the policy term (typically 10, 20, or 30 years). The most affordable type of life insurance. Does not build cash value.
life_health.ky_requirement: Not required. Recommended for anyone with dependents, a mortgage, or debts that would burden survivors.

life_health.name: Whole Life
life_health.title_tag: Whole Life Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
life_health.meta_description: Whole life insurance provides permanent coverage with guaranteed cash value growth. Compare to term life and universal life options.
life_health.h1: What is the difference between whole life and term life insurance?
life_health.summary: Permanent life insurance that covers you for your entire life with level premiums, a guaranteed death benefit, and cash value that grows over time. More expensive than term but lasts forever and builds an asset.
life_health.typical_cost_range: $150–$500+/month for $250K coverage (varies widely by age and health)
life_health.ky_requirement: Not required. Used for estate planning, final expenses, supplemental retirement income, and lifelong coverage needs.

life_health.name: Annuities
life_health.title_tag: Annuities in Kentucky | The Way Agency
life_health.meta_description: Annuities provide guaranteed income in retirement. Learn about fixed, indexed, and variable annuity options in Kentucky.
life_health.summary: A contract with an insurance company that provides guaranteed income payments, either immediately or at a future date. Used for retirement income planning, tax-deferred growth, and protection against outliving your savings.

life_health.name: Disability Insurance
life_health.title_tag: Disability Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
life_health.meta_description: Disability insurance replaces a portion of your income if you're unable to work due to illness or injury. Individual and group options in Kentucky.
life_health.summary: Replaces a portion of your income (typically 50–70%) if you're unable to work due to illness or injury. Available as short-term (3–6 months) or long-term (years to age 65) coverage.
life_health.typical_cost_range: 1%–3% of your annual income for long-term disability
life_health.ky_requirement: Not required. Kentucky does not have state disability insurance. Social Security disability exists but has strict qualification criteria and long wait times.
common_exclusions: injuries during commission of a crime

life_health.name: Final Expense
life_health.title_tag: Final Expense Insurance in Kentucky | The Way Agency
life_health.meta_description: Final expense insurance covers funeral costs, medical bills, and outstanding debts so your family is not burdened. Simplified underwriting available.
life_health.summary: A smaller whole life policy (typically $5,000–$25,000) designed to cover funeral and burial costs, outstanding medical bills, and small debts. Simplified underwriting means no medical exam required for most applicants.
life_health.typical_cost_range: $30–$100/month depending on age and coverage amount
life_health.ky_requirement: Not required. Designed for seniors and those who want to ensure their family is not burdened with funeral costs averaging $7,000–$12,000.
common_exclusions: graded benefit policies may limit payout in first 2 years to return of premiums plus interest for non-accidental death
